ayahs.textUthmani: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ ۝١
ayahs.textIndopak: اِقْتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَانْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ
ayahs.translation: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].[1577]

footnotes.1577: This was a sign given by Allāh to Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) when the Quraysh challenged him to show them a miracle.

ayahs.translationClear: The Hour has drawn near, and the moon has split.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ ۝٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنْ يَّرَوْا اٰيَةً يُّعْرِضُوْا وَيَقُوْلُوْا سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
ayahs.translation: And if they see a sign [i.e., miracle], they turn away and say, "Passing magic."[1578]
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'in yaraw aayatan yu'ridoo wayaqooloo sihrum mustamirr
ayahs.translationClear: Yet whenever they see a miracle, they turn away, and say, “Continuous magic.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ‌ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ ۝٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَكَذَّبُوْا وَاتَّبَعُوْٓا اَهْوَا࢜ءَهُمْ وَكُلُّ اَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
ayahs.translation: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.
ayahs.transliteration: Wakadhdhaboo wattaba'oo ahwaa'ahum wakullu amrim mustaqirr
ayahs.translationClear: They lied, and followed their opinions, but everything has its time.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ ۝٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ جَا࢜ءَهُمْ مِّنَ الْاَنۢ͏ْبَا࢜ءِ مَا فِيْهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad jaa'ahum minal-ambaa'i maa feehi muzdajar
ayahs.translationClear: And there came to them news containing a deterrent.

ayahs.textUthmani: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌ‌ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ ۝٥
ayahs.textIndopak: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَالِغَةٌ فَمَا تُغْنِ النُّذُرُ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].
ayahs.translationClear: Profound wisdom—but warnings are of no avail.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ‌ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ ۝٦
ayahs.textIndopak: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ الدَّاعِ اِلٰي شَيْءٍ نُّكُرٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: So leave them, [O Muḥammad]. The Day the Caller[1579] calls to something forbidding,
ayahs.transliteration: Fatawalla 'anhum yawma yad'ud-daa'i ilaa shay'in nukur

footnotes.1579: Said to be an angel announcing the account and judgement.

ayahs.translationClear: So turn away from them. On the Day when the Caller calls to something terrible.

ayahs.textUthmani: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ ۝٧
ayahs.textIndopak: خُشَّعًا اَبْصَارُهُمْ يَخْرُجُوْنَ مِنَ الْاَجْدَاثِ كَاَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنْتَشِرٌ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,
ayahs.transliteration: Khushsha'an absaaruhum yakhrujoona minal-ajdaathi ka'annahum jaraadum muntashir
ayahs.translationClear: Their eyes humiliated, they will emerge from the graves, as if they were swarming locusts.

ayahs.textUthmani: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ‌ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ ۝٨
ayahs.textIndopak: مُّهْطِعِيْنَ اِلَي الدَّاعِؕ يَقُوْلُ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ هٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
ayahs.translation: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."
ayahs.translationClear: Scrambling towards the Caller, the disbelievers will say, “This is a difficult Day.”

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ ۝٩
ayahs.textIndopak: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوْحٍ فَكَذَّبُوْا عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوْا مَجْنُوْنٌ وَّازْدُجِرَ
ayahs.translation: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.
ayahs.transliteration: Kadhdhabat qablahum qawmu noohin fakadhdhaboo 'abdanaa waqaaloo majnoonun wazdujir
ayahs.translationClear: Before them the people of Noah disbelieved. They rejected Our servant, and said, “Crazy,” and he was rebuked.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ ۝١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: فَدَعَا رَبَّهٗٓ اَنِّيْ مَغْلُوْبٌ فَانْتَصِرْ
ayahs.translation: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."
ayahs.translationClear: So he appealed to his Lord, “I am overwhelmed, so help me.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ ۝١١
ayahs.textIndopak: فَفَتَحْنَا͏ٓ اَبْوَابَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ بِمَا࢜ءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ ؗۖ
ayahs.translation: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down
ayahs.translationClear: So We opened the floodgates of heaven with water pouring down.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ ۝١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّفَجَّرْنَا الْاَرْضَ عُيُوْنًا فَالْتَقَي الْمَا࢜ءُ عَلٰٓي اَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.
ayahs.translationClear: And We made the earth burst with springs, and the waters met for a purpose already destined.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ ۝١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَحَمَلْنٰهُ عَلٰي ذَاتِ اَلْوَاحٍ وَّدُسُرٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,
ayahs.translationClear: And We carried him on a craft of planks and nails.

ayahs.textUthmani: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ ۝١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: تَجْرِيْ بِاَعْيُنِنَاۚ جَزَا࢜ءً لِّمَنْ كَانَ كُفِرَ
ayahs.translation: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.
ayahs.transliteration: Tajree bi'a'yuninaa jazaa'al liman kaana kufir
ayahs.translationClear: Sailing before Our eyes; a reward for him who was rejected.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ ۝١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ تَّرَكْنٰهَا͏ٓ اٰيَةً فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.translation: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad taraknaahaa aayatan fahal mim muddakir
ayahs.translationClear: And We left it as a sign. Is there anyone who would take heed?

ayahs.textUthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ ۝١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِيْ وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.translation: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.[1580]

footnotes.1580: To those after them, who were expected to derive a lesson from previous occurrences.

ayahs.translationClear: So how were My punishment and My warnings?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ ۝١٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْاٰنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad yassarnal-qur'aana lidhdhikri fahal mim muddakir
ayahs.translationClear: We made the Quran easy to learn. Is there anyone who would learn?

ayahs.textUthmani: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِيْ وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.translation: ʿAad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
ayahs.translationClear: Aad denied the truth. So how were My punishment and My warnings?

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ ۝١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّا͏ٓ اَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيْحًا صَرْصَرًا فِيْ يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa arsalnaa 'alayhim reehan sarsaran fee yawmi nahsim mustamirr
ayahs.translationClear: We unleashed upon them a screaming wind, on a day of unrelenting misery.

ayahs.textUthmani: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ ۝٢٠
ayahs.textIndopak: تَنْزِعُ النَّاسَۙ كَاَنَّهُمْ اَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنْقَعِرٍ
ayahs.translation: Extracting the people[1581] as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.
ayahs.translationClear: Plucking the people away, as though they were trunks of uprooted palm-trees.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ ۝٢١
ayahs.textIndopak: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِيْ وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.translation: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
ayahs.translationClear: So how were My punishment and My warnings?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ ۝٢٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْاٰنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad yassarnal-qur'aana lidhdhikri fahal mim muddakir
ayahs.translationClear: We made the Quran easy to remember. Is there anyone who would remember?

ayahs.textUthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ ۝٢٣
ayahs.textIndopak: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُوْدُ بِالنُّذُرِ
ayahs.translation: Thamūd denied the warning.
ayahs.translationClear: Thamood rejected the warnings.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ ۝٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: فَقَالُوْٓا اَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَاحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهٗٓۙ اِنَّا͏ٓ اِذًا لَّفِيْ ضَلٰلٍ وَّسُعُرٍ
ayahs.translation: And said, "Is it one human being[1582] among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.
ayahs.transliteration: Faqaaloo abasharam minnaa waahidan nattabi'uhoo innaa idhal lafee dalaalin wasu'ur
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “Are we to follow one of us, a human being? We would then go astray, and end up in Hell.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ ۝٢٥
ayahs.textIndopak: ءَاُلْقِيَ الذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنْۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ اَشِرٌ
ayahs.translation: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."
ayahs.transliteration: A'ulqiyadh-dhikru 'alayhi mim bayninaa bal huwa kadhdhaabun ashir
ayahs.translationClear: Was the message given to him, out of all of us? In fact, he is a wicked liar.”

ayahs.textUthmani: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ ۝٢٦
ayahs.textIndopak: سَيَعْلَمُوْنَ غَدًا مَّنِ الْكَذَّابُ الْاَشِرُ
ayahs.translation: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.
ayahs.translationClear: They will know tomorrow who the wicked liar is.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ ۝٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا النَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَارْتَقِبْهُمْ وَاصْطَبِرْ ؗ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.[1583]
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa mursilun-naaqati fitnatal lahum fartaqibhum wastabir

footnotes.1583: This and the following verse are an address to Ṣāliḥ (upon him be peace).

ayahs.translationClear: We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and be patient.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ‌ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ ۝٢٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَنَبِّي͏ٔ͏ْهُمْ اَنَّ الْمَا࢜ءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْۚ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
ayahs.translation: And inform them that the water is shared between them,[1584] each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
ayahs.transliteration: Wanabbi'hum annal-maa'a qismatum baynahum kullu shirbim muhtadar

footnotes.1584: i.e., between the tribe of Thamūd and the she-camel - a day for each to drink.

ayahs.translationClear: And inform them that the water is to be shared between them; each share of drink made available.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ ۝٢٩
ayahs.textIndopak: فَنَادَوْا صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطٰي فَعَقَرَ
ayahs.translation: But they called their companion,[1585] and he dared[1586] and hamstrung [her].

footnotes.1585: i.e., the worst and most despicable among them.
footnotes.1586: Or "he took," referring to his sword or to the she-camel.

ayahs.translationClear: But they called their friend, and he dared, and he slaughtered.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ ۝٣٠
ayahs.textIndopak: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِيْ وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.translation: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
ayahs.translationClear: So how were My punishment and My warnings?

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ ۝٣١
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّا͏ٓ اَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَّاحِدَةً فَكَانُوْا كَهَشِيْمِ الْمُحْتَظِرِ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa arsalnaa 'alayhim sayhatan waahidatan fakaanoo kahasheemil-muhtazir
ayahs.translationClear: We sent against them a single Scream, and they became like crushed hay.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ ۝٣٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْاٰنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad yassarnal-qur'aana lidhdhikri fahal mim muddakir
ayahs.translationClear: We made the Quran easy to understand. Is there anyone who would understand?

ayahs.textUthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ ۝٣٣
ayahs.textIndopak: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوْطٍۢ بِالنُّذُرِ
ayahs.translation: The people of Lot denied the warning.
ayahs.translationClear: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ‌ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ ۝٣٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّا͏ٓ اَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا اِلَّا͏ٓ اٰلَ لُوْطٍؕ نَجَّيْنٰهُمْ بِسَحَرٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn.
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa arsalnaa 'alayhim haasiban illaa aala lootin najjaynaahum bisahar
ayahs.translationClear: We unleashed upon them a shower of stones, except for the family of Lot; We rescued them at dawn.

ayahs.textUthmani: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا‌ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ ۝٣٥
ayahs.textIndopak: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِنْدِنَاؕ كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِيْ مَنْ شَكَرَ
ayahs.translation: As favor from Us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.
ayahs.transliteration: Ni'matam min 'indinaa kadhaalika najzee man shakar
ayahs.translationClear: A blessing from Us. Thus We reward the thankful.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ ۝٣٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ اَنْذَرَهُمْ بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا بِالنُّذُرِ
ayahs.translation: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.
ayahs.translationClear: He had warned them of Our onslaught, but they dismissed the warnings.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ ۝٣٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ رَاوَدُوْهُ عَنْ ضَيْفِهٖ فَطَمَسْنَا͏ٓ اَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوْقُوْا عَذَابِيْ وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.translation: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad raawadoohu 'an dayfihee fatamasnaa a'yunahum fadhooqoo 'adhaabee wanudhur
ayahs.translationClear: They even lusted for his guest, so We obliterated their eyes. “So taste My punishment and My warnings.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ ۝٣٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُمْ بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.
ayahs.translationClear: Early morning brought upon them enduring punishment.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ ۝٣٩
ayahs.textIndopak: فَذُوْقُوْا عَذَابِيْ وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.translation: So taste My punishment and warning.
ayahs.translationClear: “So taste My punishment and My warnings.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ ۝٤٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْاٰنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad yassarnal-qur'aana lidhdhikri fahal mim muddakir
ayahs.translationClear: We made the Quran easy to memorize. Is there anyone who would memorize?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ ۝٤١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ جَا࢜ءَ اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ النُّذُرُ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.
ayahs.translationClear: The warnings also came to the people of Pharaoh.

ayahs.textUthmani: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ ۝٤٢
ayahs.textIndopak: كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَاَخَذْنٰهُمْ اَخْذَ عَزِيْزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
ayahs.translation: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.
ayahs.transliteration: Kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa kullihaa fa'akhadhnaahum akhdha 'azeezim muqtadir
ayahs.translationClear: They rejected Our signs, all of them, so We seized them—the seizure of an Almighty Omnipotent.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ ۝٤٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ اُولٰ࢜ىِٕكُمْ اَمْ لَكُمْ بَرَا࢜ءَةٌ فِي الزُّبُرِ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scriptures?
ayahs.transliteration: Akuffaarukum khayrum min ulaa'ikum am lakum baraa'atun fiz-zubur
ayahs.translationClear: Are your unbelievers better than all those? Or do you have immunity in the scriptures?

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ ۝٤٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ يَقُوْلُوْنَ نَحْنُ جَمِيْعٌ مُّنْتَصِرٌ
ayahs.translation: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?
ayahs.translationClear: Or do they say, “We are united, and we will be victorious”?

ayahs.textUthmani: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ ۝٤٥
ayahs.textIndopak: سَيُهْزَمُ الْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّوْنَ الدُّبُرَ
ayahs.translation: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].[1587]

footnotes.1587: This foretold event took place on the day of Badr.

ayahs.translationClear: The multitude will be defeated, and they will turn their backs.

ayahs.textUthmani: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ ۝٤٦
ayahs.textIndopak: بَلِ السَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَالسَّاعَةُ اَدْهٰي وَاَمَرُّ
ayahs.translation: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.
ayahs.translationClear: The Hour is their appointed time—the Hour is more disastrous, and most bitter.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ ۝٤٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ فِيْ ضَلٰلٍ وَّسُعُرٍ ۘ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.[1588].
ayahs.translationClear: The wicked are in confusion and madness.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ ۝٤٨
ayahs.textIndopak: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُوْنَ فِي النَّارِ عَلٰي وُجُوْهِهِمْؕ ذُوْقُوْا مَسَّ سَقَرَ
ayahs.translation: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."[1589]
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma yus'haboona fin-naari 'alaa wujoohihim dhooqoo massa saqar

footnotes.1589: One of the proper names of Hell.

ayahs.translationClear: The Day when they are dragged upon their faces into the Fire: “Taste the touch of Saqar.”

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ ۝٤٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.
ayahs.translationClear: Everything We created is precisely measured.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ ۝٥٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَمْرُنَا͏ٓ اِلَّا وَاحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۢ بِالْبَصَرِ
ayahs.translation: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa amrunaa illaa waahidatun kalamhim bil-basar
ayahs.translationClear: And Our command is but once, like the twinkling of an eye.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ ۝٥١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ اَهْلَكْنَا͏ٓ اَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.translation: And We have already destroyed your kinds,[1590] so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad ahlaknaa ashyaa'akum fahal mim muddakir

footnotes.1590: i.e., those similar to you in attitude and behavior when they rejected Allāh's messengers.

ayahs.translationClear: We have destroyed your likes. Is there anyone who would ponder?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ ۝٥٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ فَعَلُوْهُ فِي الزُّبُرِ
ayahs.translation: And everything they did is in written records.
ayahs.translationClear: Everything they have done is in the Books.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ ۝٥٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَكُلُّ صَغِيْرٍ وَّكَبِيْرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
ayahs.translation: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.
ayahs.translationClear: Everything, small or large, is written down.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ ۝٥٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ فِيْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّنَهَرٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,
ayahs.translationClear: The righteous will be amidst gardens and rivers.

ayahs.textUthmani: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ ۝٥٥
ayahs.textIndopak: فِيْ مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِنْدَ مَلِيْكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.[1591]

footnotes.1591: Who accomplishes whatever He wills whenever He wills.

ayahs.translationClear: In an assembly of virtue, in the presence of an Omnipotent King.
